title: Guided forest treks you can book in Kerala
description: Compare guided forest walks, treks and booking contacts across Kerala, from Thattekkad to Periyar and Parambikulam.
intro: Explore guided forest programmes run or listed by Kerala’s reserves and tourism authorities. Some reserve pages offer online booking; others provide contact details for enquiries. These are programme descriptions, not a promise that a particular date is available. Confirm current access, charges, age rules and weather-related closures directly before travelling.

entries.name: Black Baza Trail — Thattekkad
entries.description: A guided birdwatching walk into Thattekkad Bird Sanctuary. Kerala Tourism describes a three-hour trail with a guide; ask the sanctuary whether it is operating on your dates.

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: About 3 hours, according to Kerala Tourism.

facts.label: Booking
facts.value: Enquire with the sanctuary before travel; confirm the current price and start time.

entries.name: Thoovanam Falls Trek — Chinnar
entries.description: A guided trail from Alampetty check post through Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary towards Thoovanam Falls. Confirm access and current conditions with the wildlife office.

facts.label: Distance and time
facts.value: Approximately 4 km and 3 hours as described by Kerala Tourism.

facts.label: Booking
facts.value: Contact the wildlife office; online trek availability is not confirmed.

entries.name: Nature Walk — Periyar
entries.details: Short guided forest walk · Thekkady, Idukki
entries.description: A short forest walk with a trained guide through Periyar Tiger Reserve, starting at the boat landing. Wildlife sightings are not guaranteed.

facts.label: Before booking
facts.value: Minimum group charge applies below four people; under-8s are not admitted. Park entry and bus charges are extra, according to the reserve.

entries.name: Border Hiking: Thondiyar — Periyar
entries.description: A longer guided forest hike from near Bamboo Grove. The reserve describes a demanding day with guides and a forest guard; check the route and conditions before booking.

facts.label: Before booking
facts.value: The reserve lists a minimum two-person charge, an under-12 restriction and additional park entry charges.

entries.name: Jungle Scout: Bamboo Grove — Periyar
entries.description: A guided night patrol-style trek from the Bamboo Grove area. Check the reserve page for available sessions and current requirements.

facts.label: Before booking
facts.value: Minimum group charges and age limits apply; park entry and bus charges are extra.

entries.name: Elephant Song Trekking Trail — Parambikulam
entries.description: A guided forest trek starting and ending at Anappady. The reserve describes two trained naturalists accompanying the group; the name does not promise animal sightings.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: 6 km; described by the reserve as a beginner trail.

facts.label: Before booking
facts.value: The reserve lists a five-person minimum charge and separate check-post entry charges.

entries.name: Bear Path Trekking Trail — Parambikulam
entries.description: An Anappady forest circuit accompanied by trained naturalists. The reserve describes it as an intermediate option; confirm availability and access before travelling.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: 8 km; described by the reserve as an intermediate trail.

facts.label: Before booking
facts.value: The reserve lists a five-person minimum charge and separate check-post entry charges.

entries.name: Wet ‘N’ Wild Trail — Shendurney
entries.details: Full-day guided forest trek · Kollam district
entries.description: Kerala Tourism describes a full-day Shendurney Wildlife Sanctuary trail accompanied by two guides and a forest guard. Ask the sanctuary about current operation and trail conditions.

facts.label: Distance and time
facts.value: About 18 km and 8 hours, according to Kerala Tourism.

facts.label: Booking
facts.value: The tourism page lists 8547602930 and 8547602931 for enquiries; confirm current details.

ordering.explanation: Treks are grouped alphabetically by forest area, then alphabetically by programme name; this is not a difficulty or quality ranking.
